title: Key Vault and Encryption
body:
# Azure Key Vault and Encryption Lab Report

This report documents the **steps and outcomes** of a practical exercise involving the deployment and management of **Azure resources**, with a specific focus on **Azure Key Vault** and encryption-related configurations.

## Purpose

The purpose of this lab was to simulate **real-world cloud administration and security tasks** as part of an Azure training assignment.

The exercise also emphasized **cost management** by efficiently managing, monitoring, and cleaning up deployed resources to minimize unnecessary cloud costs.
